[Act: dpdp
 Chapter: Penalties and Adjudication
 Section: 34::Crediting sums realised by way of penalties to Consolidated Fund of India.
]


All sums realised by way of penalties imposed by the Board under this Act, shall be credited to the Consolidated Fund of India.
